bioconda.name: qraft
bioconda.summary: Species trees from gene trees by quartet regrafting, at the scale of a million taxa.
bioconda.description:
QRAFT (Quartet Regrafting for Accurate and Fast Species Tree Estimation)
infers a species tree from gene trees. It looks for the species tree that
agrees with the most gene-tree quartets, counting every quartet exactly,
and it scales to very large datasets. It reads gene trees in Newick
format, which may miss taxa or hold several copies of a taxon, and writes
the species tree in Newick format, optionally with local posterior
probabilities on its edges.
